After 2024, Democrats made a very public promise to go where the voters are.
After concerns that part of Vice President Kamala Harris's defeat was due to[
"losing the internet,"](https://www.wired.com/story/the-year-democrats-lost-
the-internet/) the party spent the next two years putting its candidates on
podcasts, livestreams, and new media shows whose hosts owed them nothing - but
offered new audiences. This month, the Democratic Party won[ its largest House
majority since 1992](https://thehill.com/homenews/house/6236301-democrats-
secure-house-majority). Then on Monday, just three weeks after the election,
